ai.title: AI safety conversations have gotten unbelievable
ai.brief: This week two conversations about AI safety went viral that demonstrate just how hard it is to discern AI fact from fiction. ” While there definitely is a trend towards using more synthetic data (aka, AI-generated data) for training models, an AI security professional told me that this particular safety issue is unlikely at best. Even if the internet is actually polluted with OpenAI’s Hugging Face hacker bots, AI researchers could simply filter out that code if they came upon it.

sec.title: SolarWinds Patches ARM Hard-Coded Key Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
